name: Kuwai na Shock!
source: Sakaki Arima is a private detective. He only works on cases related to [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Youkai]youkai[/url]. He has ability to strengthen himself by having sex with female youkai, but he need to do it regularly. One day, he received a strange letter with only one sentence: "I want to see the sun". At the same time youkai catgirl came to his office and forced him to take this task...
translation: 榊有马是一名私家侦探，只承接与[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Youkai]妖怪[/url]有关的案件。他能通过与女性妖怪发生关系强化自身，但必须定期这样做。一天，他收到一封奇怪的信，里面只有一句话：“我想看看太阳。”与此同时，一名猫妖少女来到事务所，强迫他接下这份委托…
